title: Add 64-bit ZIP support
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes #124541

Currently, Godot reads and writes ZIP files with legacy 32-bit minizip APIs. This pull request upgrades to the newer 64-bit minizip APIs. This allows ZIP files larger than 4GB, while maintaining backwards compatibility.

- The `ZIPReader` class can now extract ZIP64 files as well as ZIP32.
- Built-in classes such as `ProjectZIPPacker` have been upgraded to write either ZIP32 or ZIP64 depending on the uncompressed size.
- The `ZIPPacker` class now has a new method (`open_file`), which writes in either ZIP32 or ZIP64 format depending on the `zip64` parameter:
```gdscript
var zip_packer := ZIPPacker.new()
var err: Error = zip_packer.open("output.zip")
if err != OK:
	return err

var data: PackedByteArray = "meow".to_utf8_buffer()
zip_packer.open_file("cats.txt", data.size() > UINT32_MAX)
zip_packer.write_file(data)
zip_packer.close_file()

zip_packer.close()
```

The `zip64` parameter should only be enabled if the total size is over `UINT32_MAX` (4 GiB minus one). While you could write ZIP64 format in every case, it's less compatible and efficient, and I found that 7-Zip displays an error when unzipping a small ZIP64 format file ("Headers Error").

The `start_file` method has been deprecated in favour of `open_file`.

### Demo
*Warning: This demo creates a small ZIP file (~5 MB) which extracts to over 5 GB. Avoid running this demo if your PC doesn't have much memory or storage space.*
[example-zip64-game.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33830787/example-zip64-game.zip)

## Additional information

I have searched extensively for all 32-bit ZIP APIs in Godot's codebase that can be upgraded and replaced them, but it is possible that I have missed one.

No AI used.

-			writer.start_file("hello.txt")
+			writer.open_file("hello.txt")
 			writer.write_file("Hello World".to_utf8_buffer())
 			writer.close_file()

+			<param index="0" name="path" type="String" />
+			<param index="1" name="zip64" type="bool" />
+			<param index="2" name="permissions" type="int" enum="FileAccess.UnixPermissionFlags" is_bitfield="true" default="420" />
+			<param index="3" name="modified_time" type="int" default="0" />
+			<description>
+				Starts writing to a file within the archive. Only one file can be written at the same time. If [param modified_time] is set to [code]0[/code], current system time is used.
+				Must be called after [method open].
+				If [param zip64] is set to [code]true[/code], the file will be written in ZIP64 format, otherwise, in ZIP32 format. The file must be written in ZIP64 format if the total number of bytes written by [method write_file] will be greater than [constant UINT32_MAX] ([code]0xFFFFFFFF[/code]). Otherwise, the file should be written in ZIP32 format for compatibility reasons.
+			</description>
+		</method>
+		<method name="start_file" deprecated="This method does not support ZIP64. Use [method open_file] instead.">

 			<param index="2" name="modified_time" type="int" default="0" />
 			<description>
 				Starts writing to a file within the archive. Only one file can be written at the same time. If [param modified_time] is set to [code]0[/code], current system time is used.
 				Must be called after [method open].
+				The file will always be written in ZIP32 format. As such, if the file exceeds [constant UINT32_MAX] ([code]0xFFFFFFFF[/code]), then [method write_file] will fail. To write files in either ZIP32 or ZIP64 format, use [method open_file] instead.
